mailkeep.notes:
# Mailkeep 0.3.12 - New App Logo & Complete Multi-Platform Icon Suite

### Features
- Modern Multi-Layer App Logo: Designed a sleek, distinctive brand logo combining an origami envelope with layered organization tabs and an emerald keeper badge.
- Full Android Shape & Density Support: Generated adaptive icons (square, squircle, rounded rectangle, teardrop), dedicated round icons (`ic_launcher_round.png`) across all densities (mdpi, hdpi, xhdpi, xxhdpi, xxxhdpi), and `<monochrome>` themed icons for Android 13-17 wallpaper color palettes.
- Multi-Platform Desktop & Web Icons: Created multi-resolution Windows `app_icon.ico` (16 to 256px), full macOS `AppIcon.appiconset` (16 to 1024px), and updated the PNSJY Store hub icon.
- Google Play Store High-Res Graphics: Updated the 512x512 Play Store icon, 1024x500 feature graphic, and all 8 showcase screenshots.

### Bug fixes
- Fixed missing `ic_launcher_round.png` across legacy Android density folders to prevent launcher fallback clipping.
- Ensured adaptive foreground layers stay strictly within the 66% safe-zone radius to eliminate any circular mask clipping.

routerwarden.notes:
Router Warden 1.1.0 - Smoother updates

### Features
- Update downloads can be paused, resumed from where they stopped, stopped, and retried after a network drop.
- Old update files are deleted automatically after an update installs.

### Bug fixes
- The release signing key is pinned in the repo, so updates built on any machine install over this version.
